rec.name: Configurable PDP Buy Box (fully block-based, with variant, subscription, payment and price-per-portion options)
rec.status: Backlog — spec / requirements list (no build confirmed)

what.text: A fully modular PDP buy box in which every element is a theme block, including product title, price, variants, quantity, CTA, payment icons, USPs and legal notes. The box and the area behind it can be styled (box color, background color, background shadow). The top and bottom blocks sit flush with the box edges, with no extra spacing. The box bundles these features: (1) variant selectors with style options (square, rounded, image swatches), highlighted selected state, a 'Bestseller' badge and discount badges; (2) configurable quantity buttons; (3) a subscription display with tabs for one-time purchase vs. subscription, each with its own benefits; (4) styling for legal notes and base prices (font size, color, placed below or beside the price); (5) payment icons with custom uploads and ordering; (6) an installment-payment display (Klarna popup or own term and interest rate); (7) a 'price per portion' indicator. The screenshots show the following reference UI: rating + title + price + 'Only €0.19 per shower' bubble, short description, benefit bullets, stock bar, dark CTA with a sub-line, payment icon row and shipping info cards. They also show icon-based trust bullets with a Klarna line and a USP icon grid.

why.text: The buy box is where the purchase decision is made, so clarity and trust here have the biggest effect on conversion. Highlighted selected variants and a 'Bestseller' badge give social proof and reduce choice paralysis. Discount badges tied to the strike-through price make the saving visible. Price per portion, and installment amounts or Klarna, reframe a high sticker price as a small daily or per-use cost (price anchoring, pain-of-paying reduction). A subscription tab with its own benefits clarifies the value of recurring purchase and can raise LTV. Payment icons, guarantee bullets and shipping USPs reduce perceived risk right next to the CTA. Block-level control lets the team A/B test each lever quickly.

how.text: 1) Rebuild the buy box as a Shopify section in which every element is a block (title, rating, price, description, USP list, variant picker, quantity, subscription tabs, CTA, payment icons, legal/base price, price per portion, stock bar, info cards). 2) Add global color settings (box color, outer background color, background shadow). Each block also gets its own color setting, which overrides the global value. 3) Remove top and bottom padding on the first and last blocks so they sit flush with the box edge. 4) Variants: a style selector (square / rounded / image), selected-state color and highlight, an optional centered or left-aligned layout and optional full-width layout. The Bestseller badge has configurable text, color and target variant. Discount badges are pulled automatically from the strike-through price and have configurable colors. The default selected variant is set via a metafield. Optionally, separately listed products that are really variants can be linked as variants on the PDP. 5) Quantity buttons are definable in the editor. Whether the logic should be custom or use a Bundles app is still to be decided. 6) Subscriptions: tabs for one-time purchase and subscription, each with separate benefits. Compatibility with Recharge and Shopify subscription apps must be checked. 7) Legal notes and base price: font size and color settings, placed below or to the right of the price. 8) Payment icons: a visual style option (reference zoelu.com), fix the Klarna Pay Later icon, support custom icon uploads, add Swift as a default icon, and add custom Prepayment and Pay-on-invoice icons. Icon order should be configurable. How to maintain the order so that cart and PDP stay consistent is an open question (a shared global setting or snippet is suggested, inferred). 9) Installments: store a term and an interest rate to calculate the installment. Offer an easy Klarna integration so the Klarna popup is available. Adapt the section to the vegardians.de bestseller-bundle example. 10) Price per portion: the number of portions comes from a global editor setting or a product metafield. The layout follows the referenced Figma wireframes (TrueNature, Berserker) or the screenshots.

items: Global box color, outer background color and background shadow
Per-block color override of the global color
Variant style: square / rounded / image
Selected-variant color and highlight
Bestseller badge: text, color, target variant
Discount badge color (value pulled from the strike-through price)
Default selected variant (metafield)
Variant alignment: centered / left, optional full width
Quantity button definition
Subscription tabs (one-time / subscription) with separate benefits per tab
Legal note and base price: font size, color, position (below / right of price)
Payment icons: visual style, custom upload, order, Swift, prepayment, invoice, Klarna Pay Later fix
Installment: term (months) and interest rate; Klarna popup option
Price per portion: portion count (global or metafield) and display style

dependencies.text: Product metafields for the default variant and portions per product. Subscription app compatibility (Recharge or Shopify Subscriptions) is still to be verified. Optionally a Bundles app for quantity logic, and Klarna on-site messaging for the popup. Custom payment icon assets (Swift, prepayment, invoice). Payment icon order must be shared with the cart page so it stays consistent, and how to maintain this is still open. A theme where the PDP buy box is built from sections and blocks.

images.caption: Reference buy box layout: rating, title and price, 'Only €0.19 per shower' price-per-use bubble, benefit bullets, stock bar, dark CTA with a sub-line, payment icon row and two shipping info cards on a tinted card.
Payment icon row (G Pay, Mastercard, Apple Pay, PayPal, Visa, Klarna) directly below the CTA, and a small price-per-portion bubble next to the price.
CTA button followed by icon-based trust bullets: 100% money-back guarantee, in stock with delivery in a few days, and a Klarna 'shop now, pay in 30 days' line.
Icon bullet list on a tinted background: free shipping, 100-day returns, free spare-parts service, Klarna 'pay by invoice in 30 days'. Shows the benefit list style.

USP icon grid in a 2x2 layout (money-back guarantee, loyalty points, free shipping, climate-neutral shipping) with round green icons. It can serve as a benefits-block style reference, but the ticket does not say explicitly where it is used.
